Title: 'include' itself issue?

```js
models.Booking
.findAll({
attributes: ['id'], // for testing
include: [
{
model: models.Room,
attributes: ['name'], // for testing
where: { pensionId: request.params.pensionId }
}
]

```

## What do you expect to happen?
The sql I wanted is
````select * from [Booking] inner join [Room] room on room.pensionId = 'Foo'````
this comes out exactly what i want. (tested on heidisql)


## What is actually happening?
However, it comes
````SELECT [Booking].[id], [Room].[id] AS [Room.id], [Room].[name] AS [Room.name] FROM [Booking] AS [Booking] INNER JOIN [Room] AS [Room] ON [Booking].[roomId] = [Room].[id] AND [Room].[pensionId] = N'Foo';````

Problem is why automatically include this clause????
````[Booking].[roomId] = [Room].[id]````
this will be perfect without above clause.


__Dialect:__ mssql
